messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-alerts: token_count_drift detected (eu-west ingest). severity=page. impacted=~9 customers. notify=#oncall,#billing :rotating_light:
rachel_metrics: noticed delayed deltas in the usage pipeline starting ~02:12 UTC. Spike in recorded > expected for multiple customers. sample: cust-002 expected 10,120 -> recorded 12,540 (+2,420).
tom_oncall: paging in. looking at ingress proxies and emitter traces. can anyone check the proxy logs?
ops_bot: grep logs -> `/var/log/proxy/proxy-2026-03-21.log` shows many 504s followed by client retries, and `x-request-id` duplicates across retries.
ken_sre: that suggests at-least-once replay from frontend causing duplicate tokens to be recorded by meter-emitter. Are these writing to production ledger or just shadow?
rachel_metrics: both shadow & master paths show uptick. master ledger writes are gated by the reconciler but looks like the reconcile job accepted entries for the window 02:10-02:25.
priya_billing: hold on emails. Customers may be receiving overage alerts. I'm disabling the billing-notify queue now. `/servicectl stop billing-notify` -> ok.
tom_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit ingress retries at proxy, 2) pause emitter-to-ledger writes (quarantine), 3) run dedupe/backfill for affected window, 4) assess customer notifications/credits.
ken_sre: applying proxy rate-limit: `nginx set limit_req zone=burst5` -> applied. reducing client retries from 5 -> 1.
ops_bot: quarantining emitter writes: `POST /admin/quarantine?service=meter-emitter` -> 200 quarantined.
rachel_metrics: starting dedupe job (job=dedupe-5678) against master ledger window 2026-03-21T02:05Z -> 2026-03-21T02:30Z. running dry-run first.
priya_billing: who has a list of customers who already got emails? support-ops says 5 customers received flagged-notices. please push IDs.
tom_oncall: pushing list to #billing-private.
ken_sre: dry-run dedupe preview: `checked 9 customers, duplicates: 7, token_correction: -18,730`
rachel_metrics: that's significant. master credit writes were small amounts but aggregated. we'll hold credits until we confirm final numbers.
priya_billing: agreed pause. sending internal support note: "We paused outgoing billing notifications while we validate signals. No charges posted yet. We'll follow up within 2 hours."
tom_oncall: dedupe finished: `duplicates:7, corrected:-18720, affected_overage_flags:6`. pushing reconciled ledger to readonly staging for QA.
ken_sre: verify that reconciler won't replay these corrections into billing twice. reconciler runs idempotent writes, double-checking transaction IDs.
rachel_metrics: reconciler reported successful corrections and flagged transactions as deduped. post-correct audit: expected vs actual within +/-5 tokens for 8/9 customers; one customer (cust-002) still shows +12 tokens (normal burst).
priya_billing: OK to issue courtesy credits for the 6 customers with false overage flags. I'll create credit tasks and notify support to offer apologies.
ops_bot: proxy autopilot shows retry flood normalized after rate-limit. no further duplicate x-request-id seen.
tom_oncall: bringing emitter back online in shadow-only mode first: `kubectl scale deploy meter-emitter --replicas=1 --namespace=meter` -> done (shadow-only). will monitor for 15m before full lift.
ken_sre: created ticket SRE-2021 to add idempotency keys on emitter writes and to make reconciler reject duplicates more aggressively.
rachel_metrics: RCA draft: root cause = ingress proxy 504/retry pattern + frontend retries lacking unique idempotency header -> duplicate events recorded -> reconciler acceptance for a short window -> overage flags. remediation: add client-side idempotency header, emitter dedupe by request-id, improved alerting for sudden token delta deltas.
priya_billing: support message queued and credits scheduled. will share copy of customer message in #billing.
tom_oncall: status -> mitigated, monitoring. leaving incident open for postmortem and SRE/Infra follow-up. react :white_check_mark: when done.
incident-bot: incident updated: severity -> monitoring, pager cleared.
